STRATEGY_1_CONTROL_BASELINE.description: Standard frozen Gate 5.21 candidate: raw BGE reranker logits with 0.85x multiplier for -HYB-000 overview chunks.

STRATEGY_2_DENSE_RERANK_FUSION.description: Blends normalized dense similarity with cross-encoder score to anchor topical document identity: final_score = rerank_score + 0.15 * dense_score.

STRATEGY_3_DOMINANT_SOURCE_GATING.description: Identifies the consensus source document from the Dense Top-3 candidates. Applies a 1.20x affinity boost to chunks originating from the dominant document.

STRATEGY_4_LEXICAL_ENTITY_ANCHOR.description: Adds a small token-overlap bonus (0.05 * Jaccard overlap) to cross-encoder score to reward exact keyword presence over generic urgency language.

STRATEGY_5_DUAL_TOPICAL_LEXICAL_ANCHOR.strategy_name: Dual Topical-Lexical Anchor (Dense Fusion + Lexical Boost)
STRATEGY_5_DUAL_TOPICAL_LEXICAL_ANCHOR.description: Combines dense-reranker score fusion (lambda=0.10) with exact-entity lexical anchoring (alpha=0.03).
